stimuli.instruction: Select all images containing a bicycle.

instruction_variants.direct: Select all images containing a bicycle.
instruction_variants.semantic: Select all vehicles powered by pedals.

stimuli.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
stimuli.explanation: Four images contain a bicycle, including the child's bicycle with training wheels. Scooters, motorcycles, skateboards and cars are not bicycles, whatever their aspirations.

correct: Your understanding of bicycles has been noted.
All bicycles accounted for. A copy has been placed on file.
Correct. The Department had expected nothing less, and is mildly disappointed.
Bicycles identified. The Department is satisfied, for the time being.
partial: Partially correct. Your relationship with bicycles will be reviewed.
Some bicycles escaped your attention. They have been informed.
Partially correct. A bicycle remains unaccounted for, or a non-bicycle has been accounted for.
incorrect: Incorrect. The Department is not angry about the bicycles, merely disappointed.
Incorrect. Please do not take this personally; the Department takes it personally on your behalf.
Incorrect. The bicycles have asked not to be contacted further.
